offering_description.value: Develops and sells non-opioid pain management products for surgery and orthopedics, sold mainly to hospitals and surgical centers. Revenue comes from branded injectable drugs and a nerve-pain device, with drugs manufactured in-house.

primary_products.value: long-acting local anesthetic injection; extended-release knee pain injection; cryoneurolysis nerve-pain device

customer_segment.value: B2B: hospitals, ambulatory surgery centers, orthopedic practices, specialty distributors

end_markets.value: healthcare; hospitals; ambulatory surgery; orthopedics; pain management

revenue_model.value: product sales: branded injectable drugs and device sold to hospitals and clinics; healthcare reimbursement: insurer and Medicare payments for administered treatments

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: makes its own injectable drugs and device, sold to hospitals and clinics; brand owner: markets branded pain management products under its own name

geography_served.value: global: US primarily, international sales through partners in Europe and other regions

specialization.value: related lines: local anesthetic injection, knee pain injection and nerve-pain device for surgical and orthopedic pain

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: own sales force calling on hospitals, surgeons and clinics; distributors / dealers: specialty pharmaceutical distributors; partners / resellers: international licensing partners
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; distributors / dealers; partners / resellers

regulatory_exposure.value: high: FDA approval needed for drugs and devices, drug handling also under DEA and pharmacy rules
